summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing routine PDMR share dealings rather than a special situation. The notice details awards of ordinary shares of 31 pence each under the company's 2025 Share Value Plan to Victoria Whyte, SVP Company Secretary, and to Neil Falkingham, a person closely associated with Lynn Baxter, President Europe. Each received 10,050 shares at a deemed price of 17.9650, dated 2026-09-08, with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural mechanics stated. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
